Gautam Gambhir Addresses Cricket Performance and Criticism

Former Indian cricketer Gautam Gambhir has responded to discussions about the Indian cricket team's performance, particularly in Test matches. He stated that the team is not struggling and that his focus is on winning trophies rather than external opinions or popularity. Gambhir also offered advice to bowler Kuldeep Yadav ahead of an upcoming Test match in Colombo.
